summary: Full E2E testing of Jolly Tur performance analytics module (backend + frontend). All 10 backend pytest cases passed (filters, overview, hedef-analizi, yetkinlik-analizi, kalibrasyon, yetenek-matrisi, calisan-listesi, calisan-karnesi + 404 + region filter). Frontend E2E verified admin login, page load at /admin/rapor/jollytur/jollytur, all 6 tabs present and functional (jt-tab-overview/hedef/yetkinlik/kalibrasyon/matris/karne), 5 KPI cards, segment pie, histogram, region bar chart, hedef bar/scatter/heatmap, 9-box grid with 9 clickable cells + detail modal, employee list (55 entries) + karne detail (comparison bar/hedef table/radar) loads correctly. Filters (Bölge/Şube/Rol) present and applying (Ege filter narrowed dataset). Turkish number formatting and Navy #1F3864 theme rendered correctly.

issues: Report page wrapper shows a second row of global filters (Tümü/Tüm Departmanlar/Tüm HRBP/2025) above the Jolly-specific Bölge/Şube/Rol filters. Not a bug but visually redundant — consider hiding the wrapper filters on this custom report or documenting scope.

critical_code_review_comments: routes_jolly.py imports `random` and stamps employees with random salary/gender/age at each import — non-deterministic. Fine for demo data but flag if reproducibility is expected.
gerceklesme_pct is capped with min(120, ...) at import; correct.
Employee `manager_id` string cast handles None properly (line 113).
Kalibrasyon endpoint fetches employees via `db.employees` filtered by tenant_id — depends on import step running; verified working with 55 employees.
JollyTurPage.jsx is a single 787-line file. Consider splitting each tab into its own file (>700 line threshold) for maintainability.
Filter dropdown data-testid uses lowercased Turkish label (`jt-filter-bölge`); works but non-ASCII testids can be fragile — consider ASCII slugs (bolge/sube/rol).
seed_data_creation: None (existing jollytur tenant seed: 55 employees, 309 hedefler, 490 yetkinlikler, 55 karne).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Jolly Tur module fully functional. Tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_jolly_tur.py. Frontend route: /admin/rapor/jollytur/jollytur. All data-testids follow pattern jt-tab-*, jt-filter-*, jt-box-{hx}-{yx}, jt-emp-{sicil}.
